neighbours.label: The preposition 'from' introducing a country or region of origin for people or imports.
fire: The mill imports timber from Sweden every winter.
The market sells coffee from Brazil at wholesale prices.
Visitors from Italy filled the hotel lobby.
The factory purchases machinery from Germany for its assembly line.
Students from Kenya joined the exchange program.
The airline carried tourists from Australia to the island.
The store imports cheese from France each month.
Workers from Mexico helped build the railway.
